integrity: Two separate standalone Python 3 checkers were executed and matched their recorded stdout; the universal necessity and uniqueness reduction is mathematical rather than an extrapolation from finite samples. No authorship or independent-validation claim is made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to ordinary simple three-coordinate Latin-square graphs of order at least two in pure adjacency/equality without counting. Sufficiency for the unique 64-vertex case is demonstrated by complete executable finite enumeration. There is no independent audit or conclusive historical-priority certification.
title: Unique four-variable random-graph equivalence among Latin-square graphs
